summary: Opens, holds and closes a window's one gesture or control edit: every frame shown at once, one commit at the end, nothing on Escape.
creates: the working copy of the target (its value with the open frames layered over it), demanded by the raster and every view

faults.when: A second gesture while one is open in the window.
The layer was removed (in another window) during the gesture.

lifetime: Per window; a transaction lives from its first frame to its commit or cancel.

x-friction.gap: Frames of a drag must be seen at frame rate but leave one commit, or none.
x-friction.closes: Uncommitted edits layered over a node, collapsed into one commit or dropped.
